analysis: The trial executed successfully but reduced macro validation HR@10 to 0.5863, compared with 0.5938 previously and the historical best of 0.5950. Per-category HR@10 was Movies_and_TV 0.6500, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.6350, Electronics 0.3950, and CDs_and_Vinyl 0.6650. Electronics declined from the reported prior 0.4200. These results do not support this graph contrastive configuration; they do not establish why performance declined. Allocated GPU time was 2,287.7 seconds. No test results were used.
code_summary: Retained LightGCN with a learned mixture of depths 0–2, item biases, recency-weighted target-excluded training profiles, and 32-negative sampled-softmax ranking. Added two independently edge-dropped graph views with 90% edge retention, paired reverse edges, and recomputed symmetric normalization. Applied symmetric cross-view InfoNCE to separately deduplicated users and positive items at temperature 0.2, using checkpointed chunks; total loss was ranking + 1e-4 regularizer + 0.05 contrastive. Preserved the independent SASRec expert with 16-negative sampled softmax and validation-selected reciprocal-rank fusion. Exported complete-graph embeddings and retained all four dataset routes, predictor loading, and validation protocol.
